name: Pinky Ponky 2 - Twilight Games
original_name: ぴんきぃぽんきぃ２ とわいらいとげぇむず
source:
The second chapter in the Pinky Ponky series is identical to its predecessors visually and gameplay-wise. Like in the previous game, the protagonist, a young man named Akira, must successfully seduce five young women in five different scenarios. The goal is to select dialogue choices and actions that would raise the girl's satisfaction meter and trigger the next scene. Failure to do so will break off the current scenario and end the game after the fifth one. The situations are fairly traditional compared to the third game, involving encounters on a train, in an amusement park, in an apartment complex, etc.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/58839/pinky-ponky-dai-2-shu-twilight-games/]MobyGames[/url]]

Scenarios:
1. チカンに御用心 (starring Misako)
2. 着替えた水着が彼女なら (starring Akiko)
3. ある祭りの秘め事 (starring Megumi)
4. 恐怖の密室 (starring Misato)
5. お化け屋敷に連れてって (starring Sayuri)
